data.name: Najibah
data.gender_notes: Najibah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Najibah is derived from the Arabic word 'najiba' which means 'noble' or 'generous'. It is a unisex name but more commonly given to girls. The name Najibah carries the meaning “Noble, generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Najibah usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be noble and generous in thoughts and actions.
data.etymology: Najibah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najibah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Najibah
in_english.long_meaning: Najibah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'n-j-b' which means 'to be intelligent, wise, or noble'. The name signifies a person who is intelligent, wise, noble, and understanding. It is mentioned in various Islamic texts and has been used historically in Muslim cultures to denote a person with admirable qualities.
